messages:
maya: FYI customer can't open audit logs since yesterday after we applied their retention entitlement change. They see 403 on the API and the Console shows an empty list.

morgan (acme): getting `403 Forbidden` when trying to fetch /v1/audit/logs. We updated retention to 365d per compliance request earlier today.

maya: Error blob from their curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?org_id=acme-123"
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient scope: audit.logs.read",
    "type": "access_denied"
  }
}
```

samir: :eyes: Do we have a change that touched entitlement->log read permission mapping earlier? I see a DB migration for retention windows but not entitlements.

alex: infra-bot shows a config rollout at 2026-03-10T14:02:00Z for feature flag `audit_entitlement_refresh`. deploy-bot: rollout completed to prod-1 region at 14:05.

maria: Quick triage checklist: 1) Confirm customer's org_id maps to the entitlement record 2) Check API key vs OAuth token scopes 3) Repro locally with a service account token.

maya: I checked entitlements table for `acme-123` — `retention_days=365` and `audit_read=false` (that's unexpected). They reported they had read access before. I didn't see any manual change.

morgan (acme): We definitely could read logs earlier today. We didn't touch settings ourselves.

samir: If `audit_read=false` that sounds like the entitlement refresh job may have flipped defaults. Can you paste the admin audit for entitlement updates?

maya: grabbing audit: `entitlement_refresh_job` updated multiple orgs at 2026-03-10T14:01:58Z. Payload shows `default_audit_read: false` for orgs without explicit override.

alex: Root cause hypothesis: rollout changed default for orgs that lacked explicit `audit_read` flag. That would revoke console+api read access even if retention was set.

maria: Workaround: grant per-org override until we revert the rollout. Command: `UPDATE entitlements SET audit_read=true WHERE org_id='acme-123';` — we shouldn't run this without approval.

samir: We need a safer path. Customer can't access logs for compliance: escalate to product and security. I'll open an incident and tag infra. Also need a timeline for who rolled the feature flag.

maya: Customer asks for immediate workaround. Any non-GDPR-unfriendly quick fix? Could issue a service token with `audit.logs.read` scope scoped to org — but that's a manual override.

alex: We can generate a temporary admin token: `POST /v1/internal/tokens` with role `org_admin` and expiry 1h. Use in a pinch. Track the token id in the ticket.

morgan (acme): Temporary token will work for now. Appreciate quick help.

samir: Action items: 1) maya to request Prod infra to flip `audit_read=true` for acme-123 OR issue temp token 2) alex to rollback `audit_entitlement_refresh` default or patch it to preserve existing explicit true values 3) product to confirm intended default and communicate 4) maria to run quick script to find other orgs impacted and notify SRE.

maya: I'll request the flip now and request logs for any other orgs with retention set but audit_read=false.

alex: Rolling back rollout now to stop new orgs being changed. deploy-bot: rollback initiated (rollout id rf-2026-03-10-14).

infra-bot: Rollback completed at 2026-03-10T14:12:45Z in prod-1.

maria: I ran a query: found 18 orgs with retention > 30 and `audit_read=false`. Not all affected customers will notice immediately but it's a compliance risk.

samir: Putting a hold on the entitlement_refresh_job and creating a postmortem. We need an automated check to ensure entitlement defaults don't remove explicit privileges.

maya: Morgan, I can issue a temp token right now. Do you want token in-channel or raise a secure support ticket? :lock:

morgan (acme): Secure ticket please, thanks.

maya: Filed support ticket SUP-8129 and attached the token with 1h expiry. Also created incident INC-20260310-01 and tagged product/security/infra.

samir: Thanks. Next steps: patch job to keep `audit_read=true` if there is a legacy flag or an explicit user setting, and run remediation script for those 18 orgs. I'll own the PR.

alex: Also adding telemetry to alert if an entitlement update removes an active access flag for >5 customers within 10 minutes.

maria: Will prepare notes for compliance and recommend customer notification templates.

morgan (acme): Confirmed token worked and we could export logs. Thank you all. :thumbsup:

maya: Closing loop once remediation script runs and product confirms flag fix.
